recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the R5 Citation.relatedArtifact shape for FHIR-33119; any future work should come from a new current-build decision about resources that still reference Citation canonicals.
issue_request: FHIR-33119 was a Published CDS R5 Citation change request. Its description asked to change Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo.relationshipType short text from "How the cited artifact resource relates to the target artifact" to "How the cited artifact relates to the target artifact"; its final Persuasive with Modification resolution/comments shifted the approved scope to changing Citation.relatesTo to Citation.relatedArtifact and using RelatedArtifact to avoid confusion with Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo.
initial_application: The short-description correction was applied in commit e4a5ff940068bbd6bd5126c857248e5563af4b1e. The RelatedArtifact datatype simplification for Citation.relatesTo and Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo was applied in commit a519c04228cfe36a06fc82ef797d78c4f8352a16. The Jira-tagged application for FHIR-33119 was commit fa06f92316152f24e3bdbca2ec7d7892b0a373f7, which renamed Citation.relatesTo to Citation.relatedArtifact.
additional_context: CDS agenda evidence listed FHIR-33119 as the tracker to change Citation relatesTo elements to RelatedArtifact and noted overlap with FHIR-32795 and FHIR-31742. Later final R6 issues changed the model again: FHIR-49758 removed Citation.relatedArtifact and reintroduced Citation.relatesTo as a BackboneElement, and FHIR-53002 changed relatesTo.type to CodeableConcept. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 then removed Citation source files from the current branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini has no active citation resource entry, source/citation has no tracked files at HEAD, and current non-history source has no Citation.relatesTo, Citation.relatedArtifact, or Citation.citedArtifact element-path surface to edit.
